## Regeneration

The primer is generated from executable Quarto markdown. Regenerate it with:

```bash
./scripts/regen_physics_primer.sh
```

Static reference figures (committed PNGs, no Quarto needed):

```bash
python scripts/plot_force_laws.py --outdir docs/figures
```

Rendered output goes to `docs/_output/` (gitignored).
